title: Renewable Energy Development Transaction Specialist-2
description:
About Ameren Missouri
Ameren Missouri has been providing electric and gas service for more than 100 years, and our electric rates are among the lowest in the nation. Ameren Missouri's mission is to power the quality of life for our 1.2 million electric and 132,000 natural gas customers in central and eastern Missouri. Our service area covers 64 counties and more than 500 communities including the greater St. Louis area.

Our benefits include:

- Medical coverage on date of hire

- 100% employer paid cash balance pension plan

- 401(k) with company match fully vested on date of hire

Visit our Benefits & Perks Page for more information on benefits provided to regular full-time employees. ​

About The Position
The Renewable Energy Development Transaction Specialist or Sr. Renewable Energy Development Transaction Specialist will support the execution of Ameren's Generation Transformation Plan by working cross-functionally with key leaders and teams on project due diligence in support of contract negotiations and regulatory approval for renewable acquisitions – build and development transfer agreements. This individual is responsible for cross-functional team coordination and timely communication on diligence activities, status, and risks and mitigation plans identified.

Key responsibilities include:

- Build and maintain strong relationships with the Renewable Energy Development Team Leadership and Cross-functional Teams to support key activities and initiatives related to due diligence and risk assessment for renewable energy acquisitions as part of Ameren Missouri's Generation Transformation plan.

- Closely evaluate, streamline and maintain due diligence processes for acquisition of renewable energy projects. Participate in all due diligence meetings and coordinate internal and external resources to conduct due diligence activities in compliance with corporate processes to ensure continued and timely progress, identify and respond to key issues in a timely manner and systematically monitor and measure the overall status of the due diligence process.

- Ensure continuous improvement and standardization of due diligence information, deliverables and processes with each new renewable energy project. Maintain streamlined and easily accessible shared due diligence systems and/or data rooms.

- Work with all due diligence team members, leads and external experts, to develop and maintain a standardized risk assessment matrix and process for all new renewable energy projects.

- Plan and attend meetings, identify major action items and work with leadership and others to ensure resources are available to complete all renewable energy due diligence and risk assessment tasks in a timely manner.

- Assist with local, state and federal regulatory filings required for renewable energy acquisitions, specifically supporting the internal business case justifications, economic evaluation, technical and commercial due diligence data requests and regulatory filings with the Missouri Public Service Commission.

- Work closely with key functions across the enterprise including but not limited to Corporate Strategy, Innovation & Sustainability, Real Estate, Environmental, Regulatory, Economic Development & Energy Solutions, Legal, Tax, Transmission, Digital, Supply Chain & Procurement, etc.to support the development of renewable energy projects.

Qualifications
Renewable Energy Development Transaction Specialist - Bachelor’s degree from an accredited College or University is required. Two or more years of relevant professional experience is required. Experience in or knowledge of Energy Generation, Renewable Energy Development, Transaction M&A, and/or other aspects of Sustainability preferred. Project management experience preferred. Experience leading cross functional teams without direct line reporting relationships preferred.

Sr. Renewable Energy Development Transaction Specialist - Bachelor’s degree from an accredited College or University is required. Five or more years of relevant professional experience is required. Experience in or knowledge of Energy Generation, Renewable Energy Development, Transaction M&A, and/or other aspects of Sustainability preferred. Project management experience preferred. Experience leading cross functional teams without direct line reporting relationships preferred.

In addition to the above qualifications, the successful candidate will demonstrate:

- Champion learning and adaptability to the changes created by the external/internal environment.

- Excellent team, program and project management skills.

- Excellent interpersonal communications skills; able to effectively communicate and build relationships with stakeholders, process teams, leadership at all levels, and third parties.

- Ability to prioritize, schedule and complete tasks for multiple projects with overlapping schedules.

- Excellent facilitation skills for working with both internal and external parties.

- Outstanding problem solving skills – ability to identify underlying causes of key issues, draw accurate conclusions across multiple situations, and develop strong insight into complex issues.

- Highly motivated, comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment with competing priorities.

- Proactive, persistent and dependable.  Excellent time management skills.  Strong work ethic.

title: Grid Solutions Engineer
description:
About Ameren Services (B&CS)
Ameren Services provides administrative support and services to Ameren Corporation and its operating companies, subsidiaries and affiliates. Ameren Services includes a wide range of skill sets and roles, from finance and legal experts to digital and cyber specialists, plus those charged with ensuring environmental compliance and operational safety. Together, we help execute a strategy that enables Ameren to deliver superior long-term value to customers, shareholders and the environment.

Our benefits include:

- Medical coverage on date of hire

- 100% employer paid cash balance pension plan

- 401(k) with company match fully vested on date of hire

- Minimum of 15 days paid vacation and 12 paid holidays

- Paid parental leave and family caregiver leave

Visit our Benefits & Perks Page for more information on benefits provided to regular full-time employees. ​

About The Position
It has never been a more exciting time to work in the energy industry. The electric distribution grid is in transformation into a smarter, more resilient, cleaner, and greener (solar, wind) grid.  Advanced systems for grid monitoring and control will be at the forefront of these efforts. This position requires an Engineer to collaborate with a talented team within Digital and Operations to design, implement, and maintain our leading-edge technology suite known as the Distributed Energy Management System (DERMS). The DERMS platform will be utilized by Ameren's Electrical Distribution Operations and DER teams to manage and orchestrate Distributed Energy Resources (DER) and their connection to the grid. DERs are decentralized electric generators or energy storage technologies connected to the utility grid including solar farms/fields, rooftop solar, battery storage, and wind generators. From a more technical perspective the DERMS platform is designed around hybrid architecture utilizing both cloud and on-premise components. In addition, the platform will integrate with many other   technologies to enable DER Configuration, Forecasting, Optimization and Control.

In this position you will be involved in crafting and building the future of electric utility operations.

The position leverages a flexible time work schedule that follows a hybrid model: three days a week at Ameren Headquarters in St. Louis, Missouri and two remote days.   The DERMS system will have a 24x7x365 availability requirement and applicants will be required to provide off-hours support as needed.

The DERMS system is comprised of a diverse set of technologies including : Virtual Linux and Windows Servers, Multiple Database technologies (Oracle, SQL Server), Rancher Kubernetes Engine, Palo Alto Firewalls, MuleSoft Enterprise Service Bus, Splunk SIEM, Dynatrace Application Monitoring, GIS Mapping of electrical components to their physical location in ERSI based map systems.

Key responsibilities include:

- ​​Design, develop, and test a Distributed Energy Resource Management System (DERMS) across a hybrid cloud/on-premise, container-based architecture.

- Support system implementation activities, including configuration and environment setup across cloud and on-prem environments.

- Support system integration with enterprise and operational technologies, ensuring alignment with utility architecture and compliance requirements.

- Partner with internal business units and external vendors to implement DERMS use cases that enable distributed energy resource integration and grid optimization.

- Create and maintain technical documentation, including system design artifacts, runbooks, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

- Transition to ongoing operational support, including monitoring system performance, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring high system availability.

- Deliver continuous improvements through software enhancements, upgrades, and new functionality to meet evolving grid and business needs.

​​
Qualifications  - Grid Solutions Engineer

- ​​​​Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in engineering, mathematics or computer science

- ​Three or more years of directly related experience required

- ​Experience with Electric Power Distribution systems and applications such as Advanced Distribution Management System, Outage Analysis System, Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) systems, GIS Geographic Information Systems, and Electric Circuit Analysis systems preferred

- ​Experience with software applications development, relational databases, and server / network infrastructure preferred​​​

Qualifications - Senior Grid Solutions Engineer

- ​​​​Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in engineering, mathematics or computer science

- ​Five or more years of relevant experience required

​Experience with two or more of the following systems or technologies is required:

- ​Electric Power Distribution,

- ​Advanced Distribution Management System,

- ​Outage Analysis System,

- ​GIS Geographic Information System,

- ​Electric Circuit Analysis,

- ​Software applications development,

- ​Relational databases, and

- ​Server / network infrastructure

Qualifications - Lead Grid Solutions Engineer

- ​​​​Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in engineering, mathematics or computer science

- ​Seven or more years of relevant experience required

​Experience with three or more of the following systems or technologies is required:

- ​Electric Power Distribution,

- ​Advanced Distribution Management System,

- ​Outage Analysis System,

- ​GIS Geographic Information System,

- ​Electric Circuit Analysis,
